title: Connect an app
description: Approve the NeroNet app you just installed. It signs in with your account without ever seeing your password.

enter.codeHint: Eight characters, like ABCD-EFGH. The app shows it on its sign-in screen.

review.title: This app is asking to sign in as you
review.warning: Approve only if you started this on your own device just now. If you do not recognise it, deny it.
review.totpHint: Six digits. Needed because your account uses a second step.
review.selfDeclared: Stated by the app, not checked
review.scopesTitle: If you approve, this app can:
review.confirmCode: Type the code shown in the app
review.confirmCodeHint: Read it off the app's own screen. If the app shows no code, or a different one, deny this.
review.recoveryHint: One of the single-use codes you saved when you set up your authenticator.

approved.title: The app is connected
approved.body: Go back to the app. It finishes by itself in a few seconds.

denied.title: You denied it
denied.body: Nothing was connected. The code no longer works.

errors.format: A code has eight letters and numbers, like ABCD-EFGH.
errors.notFound: No app is waiting for that code. Check it against the app's screen.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Start again in the app to get a new one.
errors.used: That code was already used. Start again in the app to get a new one.
errors.mfaRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator to approve.
errors.mfaInvalid: That code is not right. Try the current one.
errors.mfaSetup: Your account needs a second step before you can approve an app. Set up your authenticator first.
errors.blocked: One of your devices is blocked. An administrator must unblock it before you add an app.
errors.installation: This installation cannot be connected. Reinstall the app and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
errors.codeRequired: Type the code shown in the app to confirm.
errors.codeMismatch: That code does not match the one on the app. If you did not start this, deny it.
errors.recoveryRequired: Enter a recovery code to approve.
errors.forbiddenRole: Your role cannot add devices, so it cannot approve an app. Ask an administrator.

list.title: Apps you signed in
list.empty: No NeroNet app is signed in with your account.

confirm.title: Sign out {{name}}?
confirm.body: The app is signed out and its connection to your network is cut right away. To use it again, sign in again with a new code.
confirm.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

list.suspendedNote: Its approval ended. Open the app and sign in again, or remove it for good.

forGood.title: Remove {{name}} for good?
forGood.body: The app is removed from your account and its device from the network, and this installation cannot sign in again. To use NeroNet on it you install the app again.

scopes.appSelf: See which account it is signed in as
scopes.exitSelect: Choose which exit your traffic uses
scopes.dropUse: Send and receive files with NeroDrop
scopes.unknown: Something this page does not recognise: deny it
